title: lucent sdk coverage --json
description: One report per module (a toolkit generated from one under its own name)

provenance.description: Where the module's declarations come from

idiomatic.description: Reached through an idiom: a getter read as a property, a completion handler called as a promise

raw.description: Callable as the platform declares it

reasons.description: Why members are unrepresentable, with how many

plumbing.description: Members left out of the counts: Swift's Hashable, Equatable and Codable plumbing (hash(into:), ==, encode(to:), init(from:), hashValue)

sdk.description: The SDK the module was read from (sdk:iphonesimulator27.0, android-sdk:36), so a baseline says which it was made with

stages.description: How many members reach each stage; null without evidence for it

members.description: With --members: each member's stage, key and reason

views.description: With --views: each view class's JSX attributes by rule
